project.readme:
Repository workflow: LIGHTWEIGHT. Scientific research: STRICT / MACHINE-GATED.
Safety: READ_ONLY_RESEARCH_ONLY_HUMAN_GATED.

Mission: Determine whether a scientifically defensible BTC derivatives strategy can identify rare attractive directional momentum opportunities, enter efficiently, manage deterministically and express through futures/options, or terminate with preserved negative evidence.

This Project is a scientific decision tree. WIP=3 unique primary derivatives research items in In Progress + Review / Gate; linked PR evidence and healthy operational services are excluded. Ordinary Cursor/provider/disclosures/bugfix/refactor PRs are outside scientific dispatch/WIP/admission. No second GitHub account/App or globally required Governance check is needed for normal repository operations. Newly introduced ruleset 24519812 was removed under the human correction; no replacement/bypass exceptions. #63/#64 are ordinary engineering, not research work.

Independent scientific review records model/family, role, isolated pre-result context, contribution history, exact reviewed commit/artifact hashes and decision. Reviewer did not design/implement; same GitHub actor jhonnyisaacc may publish review evidence. GitHub identity or mergeability alone proves no scientific independence/admission. #60 mandatory technical identity rollout is retired; optional future identities are not blockers. #56 still records the scientific reviewer/process and human economic values.

MOM-000 STOP_INSUFFICIENT_FEASIBILITY; MOM-001 not admitted. MOM-002 Draft/NEEDS_PRE_RESULT_GATE_REVIEW, scoring_authorized=false, Trial Budget 1/Trials Consumed 0. Accepted #51 foundation/Tier-B/overlap + independently accepted #58 synthetic audit + #56 human decisions + final versioned #53 contract -> #54 isolated exact final-packet approval -> official admitted/frozen manifest/all hashes -> one future authorized official scorer START. None is authorized now. #58 uses synthetic outcomes and consumes zero trials; its conditional INDETERMINATE_ASSUMPTIONS_REQUIRED finding changes no gate.

FAIL rejects the entire candidate BTC downstream branch including #59; no MOM-003 or macro/COT/Cava/X/Pana rescue. PASS requires provenance audit and human acknowledgment before only the next separately admitted phase. #59 capital/risk terms stay Parked until that future acknowledgment. Terminal states: STRATEGY_VALIDATED -> READY_FOR_CAPITAL_REVIEW (human authorization only), or RESEARCH_LINE_REJECTED (preserve evidence and stop).

Review tiers apply to Project research acceptance: MAINTENANCE tests/relevant CI/code review when available; no mandatory scientific reviewer; FOUNDATION strong technical/adversarial review; SCIENTIFIC_ADMISSION isolated pre-result exact-artifact approval; PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION separately frozen forward trial; CAPITAL human-only. Research review is a manifest/protocol requirement, not a repository permissions regime.

PR dispositions: #57/#49 MERGE_WHEN_ACCEPTED (#57 governance on canonical main first; #51 acceptance and #49 update/review for research acceptance). #26/#38/#40/#46/#50 CLOSE_EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE only after individual pinned preservation/canonical index/ledger/label/note; #50 after #51. Merging is not scoring permission. Old open/closed branches grant no continuation. Current research WIP=3 (#51/#58 Review / Gate, #55 In Progress); #52 completed through focused zero-alpha #65; #50 alone waits for #51, Program Outcome Active. Remaining scientific/human acceptances are documented in issues and repository contracts.
